text:
maria-ops: Heads-up — Acme Health flagged an oddity on their on‑prem renewal invoice (inv# OH-2026-0421). Platform fee appears split into two line items: 'PLATFORM_SERVICE' and 'PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ'. They say total equals the agreed platform fee but it's confusing their AP. Can finance confirm if PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ is a one‑time migration credit or an accidental duplicate?

sam-fin: I pulled the invoice PDF. At first glance totals line up to the SOW, but the ledger code is weird. Who filed the migration credit for this account during the last renewal?

kelly-ar: @maria-ops can you paste the invoice snippet here? If AP sees two separate descriptions they'll create two GL lines and might delay payment. We usually consolidate into a single platform fee line item unless there's an approved credit. :thinking_face:

maria-ops: attaching the snippet from the invoice (redacted):
```
Line 12: PLATFORM_SERVICE - $120,000 - SKU: PF-ENT-2025
Line 13: PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ - ($12,000) - SKU: PF-LEGACY-CREDIT
Line 14: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $30,000 - SKU: SUP-GOLD
Total due: $138,000
```
They included negative line for legacy adj which in combination nets to the expected platform fee, but description not marked as "contract credit" — AP is asking for approval doc.

sam-fin: OK the negative line suggests an applied credit. I think this was the "legacy platform consolidation" credit we approved for customers migrating from the old billing model last quarter. We should confirm the approval ID. @kelly-ar did AR record an approval for Acme Health around 2025-12?

kelly-ar: I see an approval note: Approval ID APPR-2025-1128 by Jordan (CS) for "Platform consolidation credit - Acme Health" for $12,000. It was supposed to be netted off automatically. Looks like the billing export split it into two rows instead of applying to PF SKU. I can share the approval PDF if you need it.

maria-ops: That matches. Acme's AP wants a single line labeled "Platform Fee (net of migration credit)" with a short memo referencing APPR-2025-1128. Can we route a corrected invoice or at least send a cover note?

jordan-cs: Confirmed — I approved APPR-2025-1128 on 2025-12-18. I can send an approval confirmation email to Acme's AP and CC billing. Should we also ask Billing to reissue the invoice with consolidated description?

billing-bot: Billing export job 2026-04-20-19:03 completed. Issue flagged: credit-line separation for SKUs PF-LEGACY-CREDIT. Ticket created: BILL-7842.

sam-fin: Thanks. Action items: 1) @kelly-ar attach approval PDF to this thread, 2) @billing-bot / billing team — please reissue invoice OH-2026-0421 with consolidated line and add memo "See APPR-2025-1128" OR provide a cover letter to Acme's AP. 3) I'll note the GL mapping change so AR posts to single platform revenue account.

kelly-ar: Uploading approval PDF to the AR system and will paste a link in a sec (internal doc link withheld here). PDF filename: APPR-2025-1128-Acme-PlatformCredit.pdf.

billing-bot: BILL-7842 updated: assigned to @billing-ops. ETA for reissue: 2 business days. Reissue will include consolidated line and reference ID in memo.

maria-ops: Perfect — looping in Acme contact so they don't escalate: sending them a note referencing this thread and that a corrected invoice will arrive soon. Thanks all. :pray:
